content.title: Witnessed Release | Enclosure, Scale Reveal, Dual Proof
content.summary: Establish a close witness inside an enclosure and only a partial external phenomenon through a fixed opening. Let the witness direct attention outward, give the phenomenon an unobstructed environment-scale view, then hold both reaction and spectacle together in a new composite geometry.

quick_start.input_format: Closed close-up witness + local phenomenon in fixed opening + pointing action + visible boundary release shot + independent environmental wide view + new geometric dual view
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original deep-sea observation cabin, a diver approaches the circular pressure-bearing porthole. Only a thin cyan luminescent biological ribbon is visible in the dark cobalt blue water outside the window. The amber instrument and condensation create a closed environment; the diver locks the photography cabin into the mechanical sleeve and pushes the slide, and the lens passes through the dry type sleeve, and is fixed to the external guide rail after crossing the transparent pressure-bearing boundary, without crossing the solid wall; the main screen continues to display the complete tube jellyfish belt and observation cabin, and the small round window on the lower right simultaneously shows the diver holding the console and watching. The two scales stay at the same time, and vertical split screen is not used
required_anchors: Establish one close witness inside a bounded enclosure and one partially visible external phenomenon through a fixed opening.
Use one visible directional action by the witness to transfer attention toward the external phenomenon.
Give the phenomenon one unobstructed environment-scale view without the witness dominating it.
End with a simultaneous dual proof of witness response and environmental phenomenon using a new composite geometry.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish a close witness inside an enclosure and only a partial external phenomenon through a fixed opening. Let the witness direct attention outward, give the phenomenon an unobstructed environment-scale view, then hold both reaction and spectacle together in a new composite geometry.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin with a close witness-owned view inside a bounded enclosure while an external phenomenon is partially visible through a fixed opening. Use one visible directional action to motivate a camera release from the enclosure, then give the phenomenon an independent wide-scale proof. Finish with a simultaneous dual-view device that keeps witness response and environmental magnitude readable together; the dual proof may use an inset, reflection or monitor and must not copy the source's exact split layout.

invariants.rule: Establish one close witness inside a bounded enclosure and one partially visible external phenomenon through a fixed opening.
invariants.purpose: Creates an immediate scale question with a stable near-far relation.
invariants.ablation_failure: An open wide beginning removes the witness-to-scale reveal.

invariants.rule: Use one visible directional action by the witness to transfer attention toward the external phenomenon.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unmotivated cut outside separates reaction from what is being witnessed.

invariants.rule: Release the viewpoint from the enclosure through one readable physical boundary or carrier handoff.
invariants.purpose: Turns subjective evidence into independently inspectable space.
invariants.ablation_failure: Teleporting to a wide shot loses the experiential transition.

invariants.rule: Give the phenomenon one unobstructed environment-scale view without the witness dominating it.
invariants.purpose: Proves magnitude beyond the close reaction frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: Remaining in selfie scale never validates the phenomenon's spatial extent.

invariants.rule: End with a simultaneous dual proof of witness response and environmental phenomenon using a new composite geometry.
invariants.purpose: Keeps human-scale and environment-scale evidence available together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Alternating them again weakens the final comparison and closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source wet-haired male storm chaser, black jacket and close distressed selfie performance
the source vehicle cabin, dashboard, windshield, door frame and wet road
the source tornado, lightning and storm-cloud imagery
the source exact car-selfie to door-exit to tornado-wide progression
the source left-witness/right-tornado vertical split and kinovi AI watermark

instantiations.concept: Inside an original deep-sea observation pod, a diver records a close helmet view with a thin luminous organism visible through one porthole, points to its expanding chain, sends a magnetic camera pod through a round maintenance lock, reveals the full siphonophore ribbon outside and finishes with a small circular diver inset over the wide ocean view.

instantiations.concept: In a miniature seed vault, a palm-sized survey robot is seen close inside a drawer chamber while an amber root pulse shows through a mesh slot. Its lamp arm indicates the pulse, an overhead rail carries the camera through the slot, a wide reveals a building-scale fungal lattice, and a polished steel gauge reflection retains the robot beside the full lattice.
